notes: Tu-form like the newest strings. Reused: iestatījumi, Tastatūras, Atļaut pilnu piekļuvi, starpliktuve, N1, and the app name uninflected as the locale does. N15 differs from the existing 'Saglabājiet no jebkurienes' only in register (tu, not jūs). Unsure: 'Cutling nav konta' needs the dative, which reads oddly beside an uninflected app name; F2 'bez tās' refers to full piekļuve.
